trace_quality: deduction points close exactly to max_score minus score
flags or low confidence include attention_note
no trace repeats a downstream consequence of the first material error

before_packet_freeze: Validate the existing development-only human gold privately.
Build new matched image packets from the frozen anonymous snapshot.
Bind the v5.3 prompt, v2 rubric, course specification, output schema, and skill snapshot in packet metadata.
Check M1-to-T1 lineage before any provider call.
before_provider_call: Validate all packet contracts and lineage reports.
Pin the Codex provider/model in private run metadata.
Bind the public DeepSeek release policy and require the stable Flash model.
before_public_reporting: Validate every private output against deduction_trace_v1.
Compute aggregate-only metrics and audit the public record for privacy.
Classify high-impact disagreements before attributing fault.

limitations.en: This is a v5.3 baseline preflight, not a model result. It deliberately preserves the existing v2 course rubric; a more detailed rubric is a post-analysis candidate, not a v5.3 baseline input. Any development result remains a single-course development finding and cannot establish production readiness or teacher replacement.
limitations.zh: 这是 v5.3 基线预检，不是模型结果。它刻意保留既有的 v2 课程 rubric；更细的 rubric 必须在分析之后作为新候选版本提出，不能混入 v5.3 基线。任何开发集结果都只是单课程开发发现，不能证明生产就绪或教师替代。

next_action.en: Freeze development-only M1 and T1 packets with the listed v5.3 bindings. Do not call a provider or access held-out material during packet construction.
next_action.zh: 按列出的 v5.3 绑定冻结仅开发集的 M1 与 T1 packet。构建 packet 时不得调用模型或访问留出集。
